versions.changelog:
gis-skill V5.0 introduces a comprehensive upgrade with a four-layer intelligence framework, strict execution rules, and full process automation.

- Established four-layer architecture: knowledge base, atomic Skill units, multi-Agent orchestration, and GeoEvolve self-evolution.
- Enforced V5.0 constitution and 7 hard constraints to prevent workflow shortcuts.
- Achieved 2 rounds of extensive self-verification (87 checks, 94.3% pass rate, zero critical defects).
- All atomic Skills now feature mandatory CRS validation and 3-stage compliance checks.
- Added standardized delivery artifacts (code, self-check scripts, acceptance checklists) in three output packages.
- Expanded and modularized content: covers 10+ mainstream GIS software, national/OGC standards, modern GIS stacks, error avoidance strategies, and classic industry cases.
